_purpose: Dated Indian cash-equity (delivery) cost and tax schedule. A trade is costed with the regime in force on its date. Rates are fractions of traded value unless noted.
_verification: status=verified means checked against a primary/broker schedule on 2026-09-26. status=VERIFY means taken from secondary summaries; confirm against the Finance Act / exchange circular before citing.

sources: https://zerodha.com/charges/ (STT 0.1% buy & sell delivery; NSE 0.00307%; SEBI Rs10/crore; stamp 0.015% buy; GST 18% on brokerage+SEBI+txn; DP Rs15.34/scrip)

stamp_duty_note: Before 1 Jul 2020 stamp duty varied by state; model as 0.01% buy-side before that date (VERIFY) and 0.015% after the uniform regime.

market_impact.model: half-spread from the Abdi-Ranaldo (2017) daily estimator + square-root impact k * sigma_daily * sqrt(order / ADV)
market_impact.note: Estimated from daily OHLC because Indian tick data is not freely available; report results at k = 0, 0.7, 1.5.

cess_on_tax.note: education cess 2% + secondary and higher education cess 1% (FY2007-08 to FY2017-18)
health and education cess 4% from FY2018-19

surcharge_note: Surcharge depends on total income and is ignored (small investor assumed).

rebalance_band.note: Continuing positions are only traded when they drift more than 25% away from target weight; entries and exits are always traded. Avoids paying the fixed DP charge on tiny trims.
